(async () => {


const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][LoveSerenade]";


// =========================


// TUNING


// =========================


const CFG = {


animationKey: "loveSerenade",


// spotlight / screen dim


spotlightLeadMs: 280,


spotlightFadeInMs: 320,


spotlightFadeOutMs: 420,


spotlightDimAlpha: 0.78,


spotlightBlur: 18,


spotlightExtraRadius: 34,

spotlightZ: 99990,

spotlightCloneZ: 100000,


// cut-in


cutinSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Overdrive.wav",


cutinSfxVol: 0.90,


cutinSlideInMs: 650,


cutinHoldMs: 850,


cutinSlideOutMs: 650,


cutinFlashPeak: 0.90,


cutinFlashDelayMs: 50,


cutinFlashInMs: 70,


cutinFlashOutMs: 170,


cutinPortraitHeightRatio: 0.90,


cutinPortraitInsetX: 220,


cutinPortraitBottomMargin: 40,


cutinPortraitYOffset: -140,


cutinZ: 999999,


// caster marker VFX


markerVfxFile: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Marker/MusicMarker_01_Regular_GreenOrange_400x400.webm",


markerStartScale: 0.20,


markerEndScale: 3.00,


markerScaleInMs: 700,


markerHoldMs: 5000,


markerFadeOutMs: 500,


markerAlpha: 1.0,


markerZ: 100100,


// ally boon VFX


boonVfxFile: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Conditions/Boon01/ConditionBoon01_019_Green_600x600.webm",


boonSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/PowerUp2.ogg",


boonSfxVol: 0.90,


boonScale: 2.00,


boonFadeInMs: 180,


boonHoldMs: 1300,


boonFadeOutMs: 350,


boonZ: 100100,


// music swap


musicTrackName: "Love_Serenade",


musicRestoreTrackName: "DRG_Boss",


musicDurationMs: 104000


};


// =========================


// HELPERS


// =========================


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function ensureONIEmit() {


globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};


if (!ONI.emit) {


ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {


const { local = true, world = false } = options;


if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);


if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });


};


}


}


async function resolveToken(input) {


if (!input) return null;


if (input?.center && input?.document) return input;


const doc = typeof input === "string" ? await fromUuid(input) : input;


if (!doc) return null;


if (doc.object?.center) return doc.object;


if (doc._object?.center) return doc._object;


if (doc.token?.object?.center) return doc.token.object;


if (doc.parent?.token?.object?.center) return doc.parent.token.object;


if (doc.actor?.getActiveTokens) {


const t = doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0];


if (t) return t;


}


return null;


}


async function resolveSourceToken(payload) {


const candidates = [


payload?.attackerUuid,


payload?.sourceTokenUuid,


payload?.casterTokenUuid,


payload?.tokenUuid,


payload?.executor?.tokenUuid,


payload?.executor?.token?.uuid,


payload?.meta?.sourceTokenUuid


].filter(Boolean);


for (const c of candidates) {


const tok = await resolveToken(c);


if (tok) return tok;


}


return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0]


?? game.user.character?.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0]


?? null;


}


function uniqueTokens(tokens) {


const seen = new Set();


return (tokens || []).filter(t => {


const id = t?.id ?? t?.document?.uuid;


if (!id || seen.has(id)) return false;


seen.add(id);


return true;


});


}


function getEnemySideAllies() {


const all = canvas.tokens?.placeables ?? [];


return all.filter(t => {


if (!t || t.document?.hidden) return false;


return Number(t.document?.disposition ?? 0) === -1;


});


}


function getCutinUrl(sourceToken) {


return foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken, "actor.system.props.cut_in_zero_power")


|| foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken, "actor.system.props.cut_in_critical")


|| foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken, "actor.system.props.sprite_standard")


|| sourceToken.actor?.img


|| sourceToken.document?.texture?.src


|| null;


}


function playSound(url, volume = 0.9, delayMs = 0) {


if (!url) return;


const seq = new Sequence();


seq.sound().file(url).volume(volume).delay(delayMs);


seq.play();


}


function playPseudo({ scriptId, scriptSource, casterToken, targetTokens = [], params = {}, meta = {} }) {


if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {


throw new Error("game.ONI.pseudo.play is not available.");


}


game.ONI.pseudo.play({


scriptId,


scriptSource,


casterTokenUuid: casterToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,


targetTokenUuids: targetTokens.map(t => t?.document?.uuid).filter(Boolean),


params,


meta


});


}


async function stopAllPlayingTracks() {


for (const playlist of game.playlists.contents) {


const playingSounds = playlist.sounds.filter(s => s.playing);


if (!playingSounds.length) continue;


const updates = playingSounds.map(s => ({


_id: s.id,


playing: false,


pausedTime: null


}));


await playlist.updateEmbeddedDocuments("PlaylistSound", updates);


}


}


async function playTrackByName(trackName) {


const wanted = String(trackName ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();


if (!wanted) return null;


for (const playlist of game.playlists.contents) {


const sound = playlist.sounds.find(s =>


String(s.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() === wanted


);


if (!sound) continue;


await playlist.updateEmbeddedDocuments("PlaylistSound", [{


_id: sound.id,


playing: true,


pausedTime: null


}]);


return { playlist, sound };


}


console.warn(TAG, `Track not found: ${trackName}`);


return null;


}


async function runLoveSerenadeMusicCue() {


try {


await stopAllPlayingTracks();


const started = await playTrackByName(CFG.musicTrackName);


if (!started) return;


await waitMs(CFG.musicDurationMs);


await stopAllPlayingTracks();


await playTrackByName(CFG.musicRestoreTrackName);


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Music cue failed:", err);


}


}


// =========================


// PSEUDO SCRIPTS


// =========================


const spotlightScript = String.raw`

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Love Serenade spotlight: missing casterToken.");


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function easeOutCubic(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

  return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}


function tweenValue(setter, from, to, durMs, ease = easeInOutCubic) {

  return new Promise(resolve => {

    const start = performance.now();

    const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

    const update = () => {

      const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

      const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

      const e = ease(t);

      setter(from + (to - from) * e, t);

      if (t >= 1) {

        ticker.remove(update);

        resolve();

      }

    };

    ticker.add(update);

  });

}


function circleRadiusForToken(token, extra = 30) {

  const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

  const w = Math.abs(baseObj?.width ?? token.w ?? 100);

  const h = Math.abs(baseObj?.height ?? token.h ?? 100);

  return Math.max(w, h) * 0.62 + Number(extra ?? 0);

}


function buildOverlay(tokens, alphaNow) {

  const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

  const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;


  const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

  g.beginFill(0x000000, 1);

  g.drawRect(0, 0, W, H);

  g.endFill();


  for (const tok of tokens) {

    if (!tok) continue;

    const r = circleRadiusForToken(tok, params.spotlightExtraRadius ?? 34);

    g.beginHole();

    g.drawCircle(tok.center.x, tok.center.y, r);

    g.endHole();

  }


  g.alpha = alphaNow;

  g.zIndex = Number(params.zOverlay ?? 99990);


  if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter && Number(params.spotlightBlur ?? 0) > 0) {

    g.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(Number(params.spotlightBlur ?? 16))];

  }


  return g;

}


async function createTokenClone(token) {

  const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

  const tex = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);


  const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


  const ax = Number(baseObj?.anchor?.x ?? 0.5);

  const ay = Number(baseObj?.anchor?.y ?? 0.5);

  sprite.anchor.set(ax, ay);


  sprite.x = token.center.x;

  sprite.y = token.center.y;

  sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zClone ?? 100000);

  sprite.rotation = Number(baseObj?.rotation ?? 0);

  sprite.alpha = Number(baseObj?.alpha ?? token.alpha ?? 1);


  // Copy the exact live token scale instead of rebuilding size from width/height.

  const scaleX = Number(baseObj?.scale?.x ?? 1);

  const scaleY = Number(baseObj?.scale?.y ?? 1);

  sprite.scale.set(scaleX, scaleY);


  return {

    token,

    baseObj,

    sprite,

    originalTokenVisible: token.visible,

    originalMeshVisible: baseObj?.visible ?? true

  };

}


const keep = [];

const pushUnique = (tok) => {

  if (!tok) return;

  if (keep.some(x => x.id === tok.id)) return;

  keep.push(tok);

};


pushUnique(casterToken);

for (const t of targetTokens) pushUnique(t);


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


let overlay = null;

const clones = [];


try {

  overlay = buildOverlay(keep, 0);

  canvas.stage.addChild(overlay);


  for (const tok of keep) {

    const entry = await createTokenClone(tok);


    if (entry.baseObj) entry.baseObj.visible = false;

    entry.token.visible = false;


    canvas.stage.addChild(entry.sprite);

    clones.push(entry);

  }


  canvas.stage.sortChildren();


  await tweenValue(

    v => { if (overlay) overlay.alpha = v; },

    0,

    Number(params.dimAlpha ?? 0.75),

    Number(params.fadeInMs ?? 320),

    easeOutCubic

  );


  await waitMs(Number(params.totalHoldMs ?? 3000));


  await tweenValue(

    v => { if (overlay) overlay.alpha = v; },

    overlay?.alpha ?? Number(params.dimAlpha ?? 0.75),

    0,

    Number(params.fadeOutMs ?? 420),

    easeOutCubic

  );


} finally {

  for (const entry of clones) {

    try {

      if (entry.sprite?.parent) entry.sprite.parent.removeChild(entry.sprite);

      entry.sprite?.destroy();

    } catch (_) {}


    try {

      if (entry.baseObj) entry.baseObj.visible = entry.originalMeshVisible;

      entry.token.visible = entry.originalTokenVisible;

    } catch (_) {}

  }


  try {

    if (overlay?.parent) overlay.parent.removeChild(overlay);

    overlay?.destroy();

  } catch (_) {}

}

`;


const cutinScript = String.raw`


const { params } = ctx;


const cutinUrl = params.cutinUrl;


if (!cutinUrl) return;


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function easeOutCubic(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }


function easeInOutCubic(t) {


return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;


}


function tweenValue(setter, from, to, durMs, ease = easeInOutCubic) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = ease(t);


setter(from + (to - from) * e, t);


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function loadTextureSafe(src) {


try { return await loadTexture(src); }


catch (err) {


console.warn("[LoveSerenade][CutIn] Failed to load texture:", src, err);


return null;


}


}


const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;


const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


const overlay = new PIXI.Container();


overlay.zIndex = Number(params.zOverlay ?? 999999);


const flash = new PIXI.Graphics();


flash.beginFill(0xFFFFFF, 1).drawRect(0, 0, W, H).endFill();


flash.alpha = 0;


let portrait = null;


try {


const tex = await loadTextureSafe(cutinUrl);


if (!tex) return;


portrait = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


portrait.anchor.set(0, 1);


const targetHeight = H * Number(params.portraitHeightRatio ?? 0.90);


const scale = targetHeight / (portrait.texture?.height || 1);


portrait.scale.set(scale);


const startX = -portrait.width - 80;


const finalX = Number(params.portraitInsetX ?? 220);


const y = (H - Number(params.portraitBottomMargin ?? 40)) + Number(params.portraitYOffset ?? -140);


portrait.x = startX;


portrait.y = y;


overlay.addChild(flash, portrait);


canvas.stage.addChild(overlay);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


await waitMs(Number(params.flashDelayMs ?? 50));


const flashIn = tweenValue(v => { flash.alpha = v; }, 0, Number(params.flashPeak ?? 0.9), Number(params.flashInMs ?? 70), easeOutCubic)


.then(() => tweenValue(v => { flash.alpha = v; }, flash.alpha, 0, Number(params.flashOutMs ?? 170), easeOutCubic));


await tweenValue(v => { portrait.x = v; }, startX, finalX, Number(params.slideInMs ?? 650), easeInOutCubic);


await flashIn;


await waitMs(Number(params.holdMs ?? 850));


await tweenValue(v => { portrait.x = v; }, portrait.x, W + 60, Number(params.slideOutMs ?? 650), easeInOutCubic);


} finally {


try {


if (overlay?.parent) overlay.parent.removeChild(overlay);


overlay?.destroy({ children: true, texture: false, baseTexture: false });


} catch (_) {}


}


`;


const markerScript = String.raw`


const { casterToken, params } = ctx;


if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Love Serenade marker: missing casterToken.");


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function easeOutBack(t) {


const c1 = 1.70158;


const c3 = c1 + 1;


return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(t - 1, 2);


}


function easeOutCubic(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }


function tweenValue(setter, from, to, durMs, ease = easeOutCubic) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = ease(t);


setter(from + (to - from) * e, t);


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function loadTextureSafe(src) {


try { return await loadTexture(src); }


catch (err) {


console.warn("[LoveSerenade][Marker] Failed to load texture:", src, err);


return null;


}


}


async function tryPlayVideoTexture(tex) {


try {


const src = tex?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;


if (src?.play) {


src.loop = true;


src.muted = true;


const p = src.play();


if (p?.catch) p.catch(() => {});


}


} catch (_) {}


}


const tex = await loadTextureSafe(params.vfxFile);


if (!tex) return;


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


const baseObj = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = casterToken.center.x;


sprite.y = casterToken.center.y;


sprite.alpha = 0;


sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zIndex ?? 100100);


if (baseObj) {


sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);


sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);


}


sprite.scale.set(Number(params.startScale ?? 0.2));


sprite.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


await tryPlayVideoTexture(tex);


try {


await Promise.all([


tweenValue(v => { sprite.alpha = v; }, 0, Number(params.alpha ?? 1), Number(params.scaleInMs ?? 700), easeOutCubic),


tweenValue(v => { sprite.scale.set(v); }, Number(params.startScale ?? 0.2), Number(params.endScale ?? 3), Number(params.scaleInMs ?? 700), easeOutBack)


]);


await waitMs(Number(params.holdMs ?? 5000));


await tweenValue(v => { sprite.alpha = v; }, sprite.alpha, 0, Number(params.fadeOutMs ?? 500), easeOutCubic);


} finally {


try {


if (sprite?.parent) sprite.parent.removeChild(sprite);


sprite?.destroy();


} catch (_) {}


}


`;


const boonScript = String.raw`


const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;


if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Love Serenade boon: missing casterToken.");


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function easeOutCubic(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }


function tweenValue(setter, from, to, durMs, ease = easeOutCubic) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = ease(t);


setter(from + (to - from) * e, t);


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function loadTextureSafe(src) {


try { return await loadTexture(src); }


catch (err) {


console.warn("[LoveSerenade][Boon] Failed to load texture:", src, err);


return null;


}


}


async function tryPlayVideoTexture(tex) {


try {


const src = tex?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;


if (src?.play) {


src.loop = true;


src.muted = true;


const p = src.play();


if (p?.catch) p.catch(() => {});


}


} catch (_) {}


}


const tex = await loadTextureSafe(params.vfxFile);


if (!tex) return;


const keep = [];


const pushUnique = (tok) => {


if (!tok) return;


if (keep.some(x => x.id === tok.id)) return;


keep.push(tok);


};


pushUnique(casterToken);


for (const t of targetTokens) pushUnique(t);


const sprites = [];


try {


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


for (const tok of keep) {


const baseObj = tok.mesh ?? tok.icon;


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = tok.center.x;


sprite.y = tok.center.y;


sprite.alpha = 0;


sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zIndex ?? 100100);


sprite.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;


if (baseObj) {


sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);


sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);


}


sprite.scale.set(Number(params.scale ?? 2.0));


canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);


sprites.push(sprite);


}


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


await tryPlayVideoTexture(tex);


await Promise.all(


sprites.map(s => tweenValue(v => { s.alpha = v; }, 0, 1, Number(params.fadeInMs ?? 180), easeOutCubic))


);


await waitMs(Number(params.holdMs ?? 1300));


await Promise.all(


sprites.map(s => tweenValue(v => { s.alpha = v; }, s.alpha, 0, Number(params.fadeOutMs ?? 350), easeOutCubic))


);


} finally {


for (const s of sprites) {


try {


if (s?.parent) s.parent.removeChild(s);


s?.destroy();


} catch (_) {}


}


}


`;


// =========================


// MAIN


// =========================


try {


if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {


ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");


return;


}


ensureONIEmit();


const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken(payload);


if (!sourceToken) {


ui.notifications.warn("Love Serenade: no caster token found.");


return;


}


const enemyAllies = uniqueTokens(getEnemySideAllies());


const allyTargets = uniqueTokens([sourceToken, ...enemyAllies]);


const cutinUrl = getCutinUrl(sourceToken);


const cutinTotalMs =


CFG.cutinSlideInMs +


CFG.cutinHoldMs +


CFG.cutinSlideOutMs +


120;


const markerTotalMs =


CFG.markerScaleInMs +


CFG.markerHoldMs +


CFG.markerFadeOutMs +


80;


const boonTotalMs =


CFG.boonFadeInMs +


CFG.boonHoldMs +


CFG.boonFadeOutMs +


80;


const spotlightHoldMs =


CFG.spotlightLeadMs +


cutinTotalMs +


markerTotalMs +


boonTotalMs +


120;


ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {


type: CFG.animationKey,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,


targetTokenIds: allyTargets.map(t => t.id),


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


}, { local: true, world: false });


// 1) Start spotlight dim / ally illumination


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.spotlight",


scriptSource: spotlightScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


targetTokens: allyTargets.filter(t => t.id !== sourceToken.id),


params: {

  dimAlpha: CFG.spotlightDimAlpha,

  fadeInMs: CFG.spotlightFadeInMs,

  fadeOutMs: CFG.spotlightFadeOutMs,

  spotlightBlur: CFG.spotlightBlur,

  spotlightExtraRadius: CFG.spotlightExtraRadius,

  totalHoldMs: spotlightHoldMs,

  zOverlay: CFG.spotlightZ,

  zClone: CFG.spotlightCloneZ

},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(CFG.spotlightLeadMs);


// 2) Cut-in


if (cutinUrl) {


playSound(CFG.cutinSfx, CFG.cutinSfxVol, 0);


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.cutin",


scriptSource: cutinScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


params: {


cutinUrl,


slideInMs: CFG.cutinSlideInMs,


holdMs: CFG.cutinHoldMs,


slideOutMs: CFG.cutinSlideOutMs,


flashPeak: CFG.cutinFlashPeak,


flashDelayMs: CFG.cutinFlashDelayMs,


flashInMs: CFG.cutinFlashInMs,


flashOutMs: CFG.cutinFlashOutMs,


portraitHeightRatio: CFG.cutinPortraitHeightRatio,


portraitInsetX: CFG.cutinPortraitInsetX,


portraitBottomMargin: CFG.cutinPortraitBottomMargin,


portraitYOffset: CFG.cutinPortraitYOffset,


zOverlay: CFG.cutinZ


},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(cutinTotalMs);


}


// 3) Caster marker VFX + music swap


void runLoveSerenadeMusicCue();


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.marker",


scriptSource: markerScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


params: {


vfxFile: CFG.markerVfxFile,


startScale: CFG.markerStartScale,


endScale: CFG.markerEndScale,


scaleInMs: CFG.markerScaleInMs,


holdMs: CFG.markerHoldMs,


fadeOutMs: CFG.markerFadeOutMs,


alpha: CFG.markerAlpha,


zIndex: CFG.markerZ


},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(markerTotalMs);


// 4) Ally boon VFX + sound


playSound(CFG.boonSfx, CFG.boonSfxVol, 0);


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.boonAllies",


scriptSource: boonScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


targetTokens: allyTargets.filter(t => t.id !== sourceToken.id),


params: {


vfxFile: CFG.boonVfxFile,


scale: CFG.boonScale,


fadeInMs: CFG.boonFadeInMs,


holdMs: CFG.boonHoldMs,


fadeOutMs: CFG.boonFadeOutMs,


zIndex: CFG.boonZ


},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(boonTotalMs);


console.log(TAG, "END");


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);


} finally {


try {


const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};
